name: Kaleido Tunnel
description: Hypnotic kaleidoscopic tunnel: PolarCoords 1/r depth mapping scrolled by Time, Kaleidoscope folding with a depth twist, Voronoi cells with glowing CosinePalette edges, a self-sampling Feedback buffer for zoom-rotate echo trails, multi-level bloom, lens chromatic aberration and vignette. Tweak it in the Parameters panel (P): Tunnel, Colour, Post and Music.

data.text:
# Kaleido Tunnel
A hypnotic kaleidoscopic tunnel: polar coordinates with a 1/r depth mapping scrolled by time, kaleidoscope folding with a depth twist, and glowing Voronoi cells, finished with echo trails and bloom.
Reacts to music: open the audio menu → Mic (the kaleidoscope twists on the beat, the palette swings on the bar).
## Tweak it in the Parameters panel
Press P (or the sliders button in the top bar): Tunnel, Colour, Post and Music settings with pretty names; hover a name for what it does, double-click a slider to reset it.
Double-click a group box to open it, Esc to come back.

## Tunnel Mapping
Screen UV → polar (angle, radius). 1/r gives depth, which twists the rotation; the kaleidoscope folds the angle, and depth + time scroll the cells toward the viewer.

## Voronoi Cells
Voronoi on the tunnel coordinates: glowing cell centers, animated edge rings (sin + smoothstep) and a second Voronoi layer for sparkle.

## Tonemap & Echo Trails
The tonemapped frame goes into a Feedback render target; each frame samples it slightly zoomed and rotated, fades it and keeps the max, leaving trails.

## Bloom
A bright pass is blurred through a chain of Feedback buffers (one blur per buffer) and three blur levels are added back.

## Music
Audio level gates everything: with the audio off or silent, drive = 0 and the piece looks exactly as before. drive = music × smoothstep(level).
- Beat: the kaleidoscope twists forward and the tunnel lunges toward you on each beat, then both glide back (Beat Surge: eased, net zero per beat).
- Bar: the palette swings ahead on each downbeat and drifts back over the bar.
- Bass: the glow rings breathe (up to +30%).
Beat-phase couplings (beat twist and lunge, bar palette swing) are also multiplied by the beat tracker's confidence and by Beat.gate (amount = drive x confidence x gate): confidence (u_beatConfidence) is 0 with the audio off, ~1 once the beat locks, 1 with the metronome; gate is the stable beat clock's certainty (u_beatTrust): after a track change the clock holds the old tempo, then glides to the new one without jumps, and the surges fade out until the new beat is trusted. Level and band couplings (bass ring glow) are not.

data.label: Scroll speed
data.description: How fast the tunnel streams toward you.

data.label: Palette phase
data.description: Cosine palette phase per channel (d): shifts the hues.

data.label: Ring glow
data.description: Brightness of the animated cell-edge rings.

data.label: Depth glow
data.description: Colour of the glow deep in the tunnel.

data.label: Echo trails
data.description: How much of the zoomed, rotated previous frame stays (feedback persistence).

data.label: Music reactivity
data.description: 0 = ignore the music. The kaleidoscope twists on the beat, the palette swings on the bar, rings breathe on the bass.
